package.name: mabel_control
package.description: ROS 2 control layer for MABEL: thin wrappers over the standalone whole-body teleoperation controller library (the `mabel` package in controller/). Hosts the controller against a MuJoCo kinematic mirror on the real robot and republishes its decision on the canonical command contract (the same topics the sim consumes), so sim and hardware share one control kernel. Provides the contract command extractor and the ROS plant adapter used by mabel_gateway.
